verdict.rationale: telli's docs describe webhooks that push data in real time by sending a POST request to a configured endpoint whenever something happens on a call, covering call events, status changes, and outcomes. That is the core of subscribing to events. The evidence is first-party only and fairly high-level. Missing for 10: an event-type catalog or per-event subscription selection, payload signing/verification and retry semantics, programmatic (API-based) webhook subscription management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
